dol.records: the record half of the content-metadata bifurcation (core) (#144)

* dol.records: the record half of the content-metadata bifurcation (core)

A Python mirror of zodal's DataProvider contract (@zodal/store), stdlib
only: the DataProvider protocol (get_list / get_one / create / update /
update_many / delete / delete_many, optional upsert and capabilities),
ListParams (sort, zodal FilterExpression filter, search, pagination;
from_dict reads zodal's JSON shape), ListResult, Capabilities, the
client-side fallbacks filter_to_function (every zodal operator; an
unknown one fails loud) and apply_query, and MappingProvider, the
reference provider over any MutableMapping of id -> record.

Part of #80 (bifurcated_provider and wrap_provider follow).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* dol.records: review fixes

- update: an explicit None id keeps the id; a rename writes before it
  deletes; update_many refuses to set the id field (no half-renames);
- records come back carrying their key as id_field (stores keyed by id
  alone work), non-mapping values raise a clear TypeError, and ids are
  used as given (generated ones are strings);
- eq/in/arrayContains* follow JS ===, sets work as values, NaN sorts
  after numbers, the filter predicate is compiled once;
- ListParams and Capabilities are keyword-only; nothing is exported
  from dol's top level (import from dol.records), so star-imports gain
  no generic names.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
